newsitem.title: USA: Jesse Jackson released after a night in jail.
newsitem.headline: Jesse Jackson released after a night in jail.

text.p: The Rev. Jesse Jackson was released from jail Tuesday following his arrest the day before during a protest at a construction site.
The civil rights leader and political activist was freed on bond as another demonstration was under way at the project, a garage at the Museum of Science and Industry.

Community activists have been protesting the firing of a black-owned subcontracting firm at the $43 million project. Jackson was charged with disorderly conduct during a prayer vigil when he allegedly blocked an entrance to the site.
